verdict.rationale: The GitHub README states the product can "Scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously" (gh-5), which matches the story almost word for word. The webhook docs confirm batch scrape jobs report start, progress and finish events asynchronously, with HMAC-signed delivery as an alternative to polling (docs-11, docs-12). The evidence is short marketing-level text, so missing for 10: detailed batch-scrape API docs (job submission, status polling, pagination of results, concurrency/rate limits, error handling for failed URLs), plus independent or hands-on confirmation of batch runs at the thousands-of-URLs scale.
